items.dari: من هر روز با بس به کار می‌روم.
items.en: I go to work by bus every day.
items.translit: Man har roz bā bas ba kār miraum.

items.dari: سفر من تا کار نیم ساعت است.
items.en: My commute to work is half an hour.
items.translit: Safar-e man tā kār nim sā'at ast.

items.dari: من صبح زود از خانه می‌روم.
items.en: I leave home early in the morning.
items.translit: Man sobh zud az khāna miraum.

items.en: On the way to work, I read the newspaper.
Some days I walk.
My work is near our house.

items.dari: من از سفر روزانه خسته می‌شوم.
items.en: I get tired from the daily commute.
items.translit: Man az safar-e rozāna khasta mishawam.

items.dari: ما آخر هفته به کوه رفتیم.
items.en: We went to the mountains on the weekend.
items.translit: Mā ākher-e hafta ba koh raftim.

items.en: The mountain air was very cool.
We sat by the river.
The mountain view was beautiful.
We took a lot of photos.

items.dari: سفر کوه سخت بود اما خوب بود.
items.en: The mountain trip was hard but good.
items.translit: Safar-e koh sakht bud ammā khub bud.

items.dari: دوست دارم دوباره به کوه بروم.
items.en: I want to go to the mountains again.
items.translit: Dost dāram dobāra ba koh beraum.

items.en: Yesterday we went to the museum.
The museum had ancient artifacts.
We saw the history of Afghanistan.
The guide explained to us.
The museum was very interesting.

items.dari: عکس گرفتن در موزیم منع بود.
items.en: Taking photos in the museum was forbidden.
items.translit: Aks gereftan dar muzim man' bud.

items.dari: ما دو ساعت در موزیم بودیم.
items.en: We were at the museum for two hours.
items.translit: Mā do sā'at dar muzim budim.

items.dari: آخر هفته به خانه خاله رفتیم.
items.en: On the weekend we went to my aunt's house.
items.translit: Ākher-e hafta ba khāna-ye khāla raftim.

items.dari: خویشاوندان ما در قندهار زندگی می‌کنند.
items.en: Our relatives live in Kandahar.
items.translit: Khwishāwandān-e mā dar Qandahār zendagi mikonand.

items.dari: مدت زیادی یکدیگر را ندیده بودیم.
items.en: We hadn't seen each other for a long time.
items.translit: Modat-e ziādi yekdigar rā nadida budim.

items.dari: فامیل ما دور هم جمع شد.
items.en: Our family gathered together.
items.translit: Famil-e mā dor-e ham jam' shod.

items.en: Our relatives became happy.
We ate together.
Seeing relatives is always good.
We rented a car.
The car's driver was kind.
The car rental was expensive.

items.dari: موتر ما را تا خانه رساند.
items.en: The car took us to the house.
items.translit: Motar mā rā tā khāna resānd.

items.en: We could not go without a car.
The driver knew the way well.
We arrived on time.
Kabul is bigger than Herat.
Herat is calmer than Kabul.

items.dari: زندگی در شهر کوچک آسان‌تر است.
items.en: Life in a small city is easier.
items.translit: Zendagi dar shahr-e kuchak āsān-tar ast.

items.en: Kabul has more traffic.

items.dari: هر دو شهر تاریخ زیبایی دارند.
items.en: Both cities have a beautiful history.
items.translit: Har do shahr tārikh-e zibāyi dārand.

items.dari: من شهر خودم را بیشتر دوست دارم.
items.en: I like my own city more.
items.translit: Man shahr-e khodam rā bishtar dost dāram.

items.dari: کدام شهر را بیشتر دوست دارید؟
items.en: Which city do you like more?
items.translit: Kodām shahr rā bishtar dost dārid?

items.en: Our school went to the museum.

items.dari: معلم ما همه شاگردان را برد.
items.en: Our teacher took all the students.
items.translit: Mo'alim-e mā hama shāgerdān rā bord.

items.en: We went by school bus.
The school trip was very interesting.
All the students were happy.
We learned a lot of things.

items.dari: معلم گفت که سفر بعدی کجاست.
items.en: The teacher said where the next trip is.
items.translit: Mo'alim goft ke safar-e ba'di kojāst.
